reference: T005 runtime compatibility probe of the frozen openapi-fetch 0.17.0 build on the real target. The standard WeChat DevTools npm build cannot emit the package entry, and the hand-made CommonJS layout used for diagnosis is not included in the preview package, so the library never loads on the device and the probe page renders blank.
head: 3f3c9310f324e4d579b51945b15ace62ca5db232

design.selector: 微信开发者工具负责原生项目编译、预览与上传

environment: iPhone 16; iOS 26.6.2; WeChat 8.0.80; runtime base library SDK 3.18.1. WeChat DevTools cask 2.02.2609250 (app build 36.6.0), CLI 127.0.0.1:32562, AppID wx746a39363f67ae95, native TypeScript compiler plugin. Frozen library openapi-fetch 0.17.0 (main dist/index.mjs, 17,662 B CJS at dist/index.cjs). Preview package TOTAL 10,458 B, which is smaller than the library file alone.

operations.action: Run DevTools CLI build-npm with openapi-fetch declared under package.json dependencies
operations.expected: DevTools packages the frozen dependency into miniprogram_npm
operations.actual: FAIL: warnings "node_modules/openapi-fetch/dist/index.mjs.js: Npm package entry file not found" and the same for openapi-typescript-helpers; no miniprogram_npm produced

operations.action: Repeat build-npm with the admitted dependency classification (openapi-fetch in devDependencies)
operations.expected: DevTools reports why the runtime package cannot be produced
operations.actual: FAIL: warning "No miniprogram_npm package was found, please check package.json -> dependencies"; no miniprogram_npm produced

operations.action: Compile a hand-made CommonJS layout (exact dist/index.cjs under apps/miniprogram/miniprogram_npm, git-ignored) and preview the probe page
operations.expected: Preview compile resolves the import and ships the library to the device
operations.actual: Compile and preview exit 0, but the preview package is only 10,458 B while the library CJS file alone is 17,662 B, so the library is not contained in the device package

operations.action: Open the probe page on the device after scanning the preview QR
operations.expected: The page shows the runtime globals report and the four request scenarios
operations.actual: FAIL: the page renders blank with no visible error; the module-level import of the unshipped library fails before the page registers

operations.action: Inspect the frozen app-side compiler constraints encountered while building the probe
operations.expected: App TypeScript is compiled according to the project compiler configuration
operations.actual: DevTools strips types without downleveling (class fields and optional chaining in app files fail parsing), so any future runtime code must avoid those syntax forms

defects.description: The frozen openapi-fetch 0.17.0 distribution cannot be built by the DevTools npm pipeline and is not shipped in the preview package; on the real target the probe page stays blank because the library import fails to load.

unverified: Actual Request/Response/Headers runtime semantics of openapi-fetch on the WeChat runtime were never exercised because the library cannot be loaded on the target.
Device 200/401/network-failure/cancel behavior of the probe remains unverified.
